title: Glowing watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fe8ff' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7fe8ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='48' cy='55' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='30' y='42' width='42' height='38' rx='8' fill='#2f8fbf'/>
  <rect x='34' y='46' width='34' height='10' rx='4' fill='#63c8f0'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M30 50 C 14 50 14 78 30 78' fill='none' stroke='#63c8f0' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M72 62 L 92 44 L 96 50 L 74 70 Z' fill='#2f8fbf'/>
  <path d='M72 62 L 92 44 L 94 47 L 73 66 Z' fill='#63c8f0'/>
  <!-- rose / sprinkler head -->
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='45' rx='7' ry='9' transform='rotate(-40 92 45)' fill='#8fe3ff'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#d6f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='93' cy='45' r='1.6' fill='#d6f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#d6f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#d6f7ff'/>
  <!-- top opening -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='42' rx='10' ry='3.5' fill='#1d6f96'/>
  <!-- water drops -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#7fe8ff'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='80' r='2' fill='#7fe8ff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='84' r='2.2' fill='#7fe8ff'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='64' r='1.8' fill='#bff4ff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='90' r='1.8' fill='#bff4ff'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <rect x='38' y='60' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#8fe3ff' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
